raw_text: URGENT: Receiving multiple videos from Churachandpur district, Manipur showing large-scale arson and mob violence. Meitei groups reportedly attacking Kuki tribal villages. At least 5 churches set on fire. Forwarded videos show armed mobs with machetes and firearms. This is escalating rapidly. State forces appear absent from affected areas. Multiple tribal organizations issuing distress calls. Internet likely to be shut down soon — archiving everything now. Share with caution, verify before re-posting.
